title: 我的工作
content: 大学毕业以后，我在一家公司工作。我的工作是帮助顾客解决问题。虽然有时要加班，压力也比较大，但是我觉得很有意思。同事们都很友好，经理也经常鼓励我们。我希望将来能有更多机会，让自己变得更优秀。
content_pinyin: dà xué bì yè yǐ hòu ， wǒ zài yī jiā gōng sī gōng zuò 。 wǒ de gōng zuò shì bāng zhù gù kè jiě jué wèn tí 。 suī rán yǒu shí yào jiā bān ， yā lì yě bǐ jiào dà ， dàn shì wǒ jué de hěn yǒu yì si 。 tóng shì men dōu hěn yǒu hǎo ， jīng lǐ yě jīng cháng gǔ lì wǒ men 。 wǒ xī wàng jiāng lái néng yǒu gèng duō jī huì ， ràng zì jǐ biàn de gèng yōu xiù 。
translation: After graduating from university, I work at a company. My job is to help customers solve problems. Although I sometimes have to work overtime and the pressure is fairly high, I find it interesting. My colleagues are all friendly, and the manager often encourages us. I hope I will have more opportunities in the future to make myself more excellent.

title: 保护环境
content: 保护环境是每个人的责任。现在很多城市的空气污染比较严重，这跟汽车太多有关。为了减少污染，我们可以多坐公共汽车，或者骑自行车。另外，节约用水用电、不乱扔垃圾，这些小事也很重要。只要大家一起努力，环境一定会变得更好。
content_pinyin: bǎo hù huán jìng shì měi gè rén de zé rèn 。 xiàn zài hěn duō chéng shì de kōng qì wū rǎn bǐ jiào yán zhòng ， zhè gēn qì chē tài duō yǒu guān 。 wèi le jiǎn shǎo wū rǎn ， wǒ men kě yǐ duō zuò gōng gòng qì chē ， huò zhě qí zì xíng chē 。 lìng wài ， jié yuē yòng shuǐ yòng diàn 、 bù luàn rēng lā jī ， zhè xiē xiǎo shì yě hěn zhòng yào 。 zhǐ yào dà jiā yì qǐ nǔ lì ， huán jìng yí dìng huì biàn de gèng hǎo 。
translation: Protecting the environment is everyone's responsibility. Now the air pollution in many cities is fairly serious, which is related to there being too many cars. To reduce pollution, we can take public buses more, or ride bikes. In addition, saving water and electricity and not littering — these small things are also important. As long as everyone works together, the environment will surely get better.

title: 网上购物
content: 随着互联网的发展，网上购物越来越受欢迎。只要用手机扫码付钱，东西很快就会送到家里，十分方便。不过，网上购物也有缺点。有时收到的东西跟图片不一样，质量也不够好。所以我觉得，买重要的东西还是应该小心一点。
content_pinyin: suí zhe hù lián wǎng de fā zhǎn ， wǎng shang gòu wù yuè lái yuè shòu huān yíng 。 zhǐ yào yòng shǒu jī sǎo mǎ fù qián ， dōng xi hěn kuài jiù huì sòng dào jiā lǐ ， shí fēn fāng biàn 。 bú guò ， wǎng shang gòu wù yě yǒu quē diǎn 。 yǒu shí shōu dào de dōng xi gēn tú piàn bù yí yàng ， zhì liàng yě bú gòu hǎo 。 suǒ yǐ wǒ jué de ， mǎi zhòng yào de dōng xi hái shi yīng gāi xiǎo xīn yī diǎn 。
translation: With the development of the internet, online shopping is more and more popular. As long as you scan a code with your phone to pay, the goods are quickly delivered home, which is very convenient. However, online shopping also has drawbacks. Sometimes what you receive is not the same as the picture, and the quality isn't good enough. So I think, for buying important things, one should still be a bit careful.

title: 一次面试
content: 上个月，我去一家公司参加面试。那天我提前半个小时到了。面试的时候，经理问了我很多问题，比如我的经历和将来的打算。虽然开始有点紧张，但是我慢慢冷静下来，认真回答每个问题。几天以后，公司通知我可以去上班了，我非常激动。
content_pinyin: shàng gè yuè ， wǒ qù yī jiā gōng sī cān jiā miàn shì 。 nà tiān wǒ tí qián bàn gè xiǎo shí dào le 。 miàn shì de shí hou ， jīng lǐ wèn le wǒ hěn duō wèn tí ， bǐ rú wǒ de jīng lì hé jiāng lái de dǎ suàn 。 suī rán kāi shǐ yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng ， dàn shì wǒ màn màn lěng jìng xià lái ， rèn zhēn huí dá měi gè wèn tí 。 jǐ tiān yǐ hòu ， gōng sī tōng zhī wǒ kě yǐ qù shàng bān le ， wǒ fēi cháng jī dòng 。
translation: Last month, I went to a company for an interview. That day I arrived half an hour early. During the interview, the manager asked me many questions, such as my experience and my future plans. Although I was a bit nervous at first, I slowly calmed down and answered each question seriously. A few days later, the company notified me I could start work, and I was very excited.

title: 健康生活
content: 为了身体健康，我们应该养成好的生活习惯。首先，要按时吃饭，少吃垃圾食品。其次，每天最好能锻炼半个小时，比如跑步或者打球。另外，休息也很重要，不要经常很晚睡觉。只有身体好，我们才能更好地学习和工作。
content_pinyin: wèi le shēn tǐ jiàn kāng ， wǒ men yīng gāi yǎng chéng hǎo de shēng huó xí guàn 。 shǒu xiān ， yào àn shí chī fàn ， shǎo chī lā jī shí pǐn 。 qí cì ， měi tiān zuì hǎo néng duàn liàn bàn gè xiǎo shí ， bǐ rú pǎo bù huò zhě dǎ qiú 。 lìng wài ， xiū xi yě hěn zhòng yào ， bú yào jīng cháng hěn wǎn shuì jiào 。 zhǐ yǒu shēn tǐ hǎo ， wǒ men cái néng gèng hǎo de xué xí hé gōng zuò 。
translation: For good health, we should develop good living habits. First, eat meals on time and eat less junk food. Second, it is best to exercise for half an hour every day, such as running or playing ball. In addition, rest is also important — don't sleep very late often. Only with a healthy body can we study and work better.

title: 我的家乡
content: 我的家乡是一个美丽的小城市，在中国的南部。那里的气候很好，一年四季都不太冷。城市里有很多公园和树林，环境特别干净。这几年，家乡发展得很快，修了新的道路，也有了不少高楼。每次回家，我都觉得家乡越来越漂亮了。
content_pinyin: wǒ de jiā xiāng shì yī gè měi lì de xiǎo chéng shì ， zài Zhōng guó de nán bù 。 nà lǐ de qì hòu hěn hǎo ， yī nián sì jì dōu bù tài lěng 。 chéng shì lǐ yǒu hěn duō gōng yuán hé shù lín ， huán jìng tè bié gān jìng 。 zhè jǐ nián ， jiā xiāng fā zhǎn de hěn kuài ， xiū le xīn de dào lù ， yě yǒu le bù shǎo gāo lóu 。 měi cì huí jiā ， wǒ dōu jué de jiā xiāng yuè lái yuè piào liang le 。
translation: My hometown is a beautiful small city, in the south of China. The climate there is nice; it's not too cold all year round. There are many parks and woods in the city, and the environment is especially clean. In recent years, my hometown has developed quickly — new roads were built, and there are quite a few tall buildings too. Every time I go home, I feel my hometown is getting prettier and prettier.
